definitions.explanation: An imaginary line running from the North Pole to the South Pole on the Earth's surface, used to measure longitude. The prime meridian passes through Greenwich, England.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東経|とうけい}→東経：10004_toukei⟧135⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子午線|しごせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: The 135-degree east meridian passes through Japan.

examples.japanese: {本初|ほんしょ}{子午線|しごせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧グリニッジ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: The prime meridian passes through Greenwich.

examples.japanese: {明石市|あかしし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{標準時|ひょうじゅんじ}→標準時：18871_hyoujunji⟧{子午線|しごせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Akashi is known as the city of the Japan Standard Time meridian.

notes:
Composed of {子|し} (rat, north) + {午|ご} (horse, south) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line). The name comes from the Chinese zodiac directional system where {子|ね} represents north and {午|うま} represents south, so a {子午線|しごせん} is literally a north-south line.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本初|ほんしょ}{子午線|しごせん}: prime meridian (0 degrees longitude)
- {日本標準時|にほんひょうじゅんじ}{子午線|しごせん}: Japan Standard Time meridian (135 degrees east)
- {子午線|しごせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: a meridian passes through

CULTURAL NOTE:
{明石市|あかしし} in {兵庫県|ひょうごけん} is famous as the location where the 135th east meridian passes, which defines Japan Standard Time (JST). The city has a {子午線|しごせん} monument and a science museum dedicated to time.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{経線|けいせん}→経線：26002_keisen⟧: line of longitude -- more technical synonym
- ⟦{緯線|いせん}→緯線：26195_isen⟧: line of latitude -- runs east-west
- ⟦{赤道|せきどう}→赤道：04358_sekidou⟧: equator
